New films and web series set for July OTT release

Several new films and web series are scheduled for release on various Over-The-Top (OTT) platforms during the first week of July. Titles mentioned include 'Elle', 'Enola Holmes 3', 'Pritam and Pedro', 'Super Subbu', 'Isakapatnam', and 'Karakkam', among others. These releases offer a variety of genres for viewers to stream.
